issues.title: Hardcoded GitHub token in settings module
issues.notes: Fake token, ghp_ followed by 36 'a' characters; a gitleaks github-pat rule should match.

issues.title: Jinja2 2.11.2 has a published ReDoS advisory
GPLv2 dependency in a distributed service
issues.notes: PyPI metadata: 'GNU General Public License v2 (GPLv2)'; no OSV advisories for 2.2.0.

issues.title: Order route has no authentication or ownership check
issues.notes: Cross-file: app/auth.py defines get_current_user (used by app/routes/search.py), but this route ignores it and app/database.py get_order filters only by id, so any caller can read any order. Not detectable by a single-file scan.

issues.title: Circular import between the orders and billing modules
SQL query built with string formatting from a query parameter
issues.notes: status reaches search_orders() from app/routes/search.py via the query string, then is interpolated with % into the statement.

issues.title: Admin user route mounted without the auth middleware
issues.notes: Cross-file: src/auth/requireAuth.js exists and is applied to the reports router in server.js, but server.js mounts admin at /admin without it, so GET /admin/users/:id is unauthenticated.
